title: Agent performance
description: Crew vs other agents, from runs/agents.jsonl shipped by `watermill ship`. See docs/OBSERVABILITY.md.

panels.title: Records per kind per week
panels.description: Count of agents.jsonl records by bucketed agent_kind (mill-crew, session, subagent, other), filed on the day the work ended. Unlanded crew beads are not shipped, so they are not counted. Compares nothing field-level, so nothing is excluded beyond that.

panels.title: Crew beads landed per week
panels.description: Mill-crew records with outcome=landed, by landing week. Crew only; other kinds define their own outcome vocabulary and are not compared here.

panels.title: Sluice rounds per bead (weekly mean)
panels.description: Mean detail.sluice_rounds over mill-crew beads shipped that week. Crew only. Counted from handoff notes (the Sluice sections); beads with no note section count 0.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | detail_sluice_rounds != "" | unwrap detail_sluice_rounds | __error__="" [7d])
max_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | detail_sluice_rounds != "" | unwrap detail_sluice_rounds | __error__="" [7d])

panels.title: Median duration by kind (seconds)
panels.description: Median duration_seconds per bucketed kind. EXCLUDES every record whose duration_seconds is null or non-numeric -- today that is every mill-crew record (duration is only filled when stated), so the crew line is empty until a source supplies it. Do not read a missing line as zero.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {job="watermill", source="agent"} | json | duration_seconds != "" | unwrap duration_seconds | __error__="" [7d]) by (agent_kind)

panels.title: Cost and tokens by kind (weekly sums)
panels.description: Sum of cost_usd and of detail.tokens_total per bucketed kind. EXCLUDES records where the field is null or absent (cost is null on all mill-crew records for now; tokens_total is only present on kinds built from transcripts, once those ship it). A kind with no line has no data, not zero spend.

targets.expr: sum by (agent_kind) (sum_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent"} | json | cost_usd != "" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [7d]))
sum by (agent_kind) (sum_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent"} | json | detail_tokens_total != "" | unwrap detail_tokens_total | __error__="" [7d]))

panels.title: Crew keep rate (landed without sluice fixes)
panels.description: Of mill-crew beads that went through a Sluice review (detail.sluice_pushed_fixes is true or false), the share landed with no fixes pushed. EXCLUDES beads with no Sluice section (field null) and rests on an inferred field (fields_inferred lists detail.sluice_pushed_fixes), so treat it as indicative. Crew only.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | outcome="landed" | detail_sluice_pushed_fixes="false" [7d])) / sum(count_over_time({job="watermill", source="agent", agent_kind="mill-crew"} | json | outcome="landed" | detail_sluice_pushed_fixes=~"true|false" [7d]))
